name: Nitrogen-Fixing & Soil Restorative Rotation
mechanics: Integrates deep-rooted legumes during post-harvest bare-field windows identified via multi-year NDVI.
benefits: Restores soil organic matter, fixes atmospheric N2 to cut synthetic fertilizer purchases, and breaks root-knot nematode pest cycles.
risks_and_gaps: Verify local mungbean/cowpea seed supply and check plot soil pH compatibility with Municipal Agriculture Office.

name: Deep-Rooting & Erosion Control Cover Crop (Bio-Tillage)
mechanics: Plants deep-rooting brassicas or grasses across NASADEM high-velocity micro-slope runoff channels.
benefits: Creates sub-surface macro-pores that accelerate water infiltration, relieve surface ponding, and anchor topsoil against heavy rain.
risks_and_gaps: Evaluate local labor or forage harvesting equipment requirements before planting.

name: Water-Conserving & Heat-Tolerant Short-Cycle Rotation
mechanics: Transitions water-intensive cereal crops during dry windows to short-cycle, low-water-demand grains.
benefits: Lowers seasonal irrigation demand while avoiding flowering-stage heat stress and diversifying household cash income.
risks_and_gaps: Review local buyer demand and farmgate price stability with extension officers.
